sloka: तत्र देवासुरे युद्धे साह्यार्थम् त्रिदिवौकसाम् ।यत्र वैश्रवणो राजा जम्बूमुपनिषेवते ॥६-२७-२१॥।।
transliteration: tatra devāsure yuddhe sāhyārtham tridivaukasām ।yatra vaiśravaṇo rājā jambūmupaniṣevate ॥6-27-21॥।।

translations.english: "O King of Rakshasas! This Vanara who is exceptional among Vanaras, a commander of troops by name Krathana, who is not boastful in wars, lives on Kailas, the king of mountains which is frequented by many Kinnaras, on which your brother king Kubera son of Vysravana stays under Jambu tree and strolls for his pleasure."
translations.hindi: यह पराक्रम में इन्द्र के समान है । यह गन्धर्वेकन्या के गर्भ से अग्नि द्वारा उत्पन्न हुआ है
